Age fit: Words stay short for ages 8 to 12. Each machine is one trade: a smaller push, a longer path.
Whether it teaches the objective: Choosing a machine draws its parts and states the ideal advantage, so a child can explain the trade and use it on a crate.
Interaction quality: A tap draws that machine and states the advantage. The tap reads the lesson machine from ArtifactKit.params.
Mobile feel: Three machine buttons sit on a thumb rail and stay large enough for a finger. The diagram fits a phone-width frame.
Tutor-guide completeness: The guide has an intro, steps, observation prompts, misconceptions, hints, and success criteria that cite machine_selected and advantage_compared.
